passages.provision_quote: Sec. 2. (a) A school shall notify in writing at least one (1) parent EH 1608—LS 7479/DI 92 3 1 of a student, if the student is an unemancipated minor, of a request 2 made by the student to change the student's: 3 (1) name; or 4 (2) pronoun, title, or word to identify the student.
passages.note: Senate-engrossed text Koch voted on: the notification section requires schools to tell a parent of any name/pronoun request, with no parent-ask trigger (excludes rung 3) and no permission requirement (the committee consent version was replaced, excluding rung 5); the bill's other section (K-3 human sexuality instruction) is in the same school gender/sexuality domain.
Senate third-reading roll call 345, Koch Yea on final passage, 37-12 (not near-unanimous).

rows.reasoning: Koch voted Yea (37-12) on final Senate passage of HB 1608 (2023), whose operative section says a school "shall notify in writing at least one (1) parent" of a student's request to change name or pronoun, matching "Require schools to notify parents" rather than notifying only when parents ask or requiring parental permission. His Nay on the Yoder amendment, which would have let a student withdraw the request to avoid notification, is consistent but only directional.
